packageRules.description: Modules patches/apply.sh patches in vendor/, and openconfig/gnmi, whose newer versions require newer goyang and ygot. A bump has to refresh the patch, so it opens on its own, and only on dashboard approval. A security update still opens, on its own (see vulnerabilityAlerts above, which repeats this list), and the patched-module label keeps the preset from labeling it automerge.
prBodyNotes: `patches/apply.sh` patches this module in `vendor/`, or, for `openconfig/gnmi`, the goyang and ygot it requires. A patch that still applies may no longer be correct for the new version, so check each one against it. The update can also move other modules `patches/apply.sh` patches; check theirs too. This update is never labeled `automerge`.

packageRules.description: Renovate merges the updates the preset labels automerge: security updates below a major version, except patched modules. It merges on a later run, once every check on the head commit has passed, not only the required ones, and the renovate-approve app has approved the pull request. Reviewers are still assigned, so one that fails reaches them.

github.com/go-redis/redis/v7 is the last release under that path; the module moved to github.com/redis/go-redis/v9. Renovate's gomod manager cannot rename a module, so a major update to the old path can never apply; it fails go get. Moving to the new module changes import paths and call sites, and is made by hand.
